proved_scope: For every rational alpha, 2*d_alpha-(alpha/2)*r equals the fixed vector t exactly.
O*d_alpha=d_(1-alpha), O*q=-q, and O*t=t+q/4 are exact rational-vector equalities.
The rational E8 lattice is defined as the union of the integer-even and half-integer-even coordinate components.
The source plane contains no point in the half-integer E8 component because two coordinates vanish identically.
A point a*d_(1/4)+b*r lies in the full rational E8 lattice exactly when a=8*s and b=l-s/2 for integers s,l.
not_proved: physical origin of d_alpha, r, q, t, or O
alpha-independence of the unmodified source character, K/time, or twist
selection of alpha or of a lattice point
source state, field realization, locality, positivity, or dynamics
equivalence to the microscopic TFPT source or a P1/P2 derivation
